sources.title: The Electrochemical Promotion of Ethylene Oxidation at a Pt/YSZ Catalyst
sources.access: Indexed author-uploaded primary text/abstract; distinct Pt/YSZ oxidation system.
sources.use: Electrical promotion, surface carbon and hysteresis are preexisting causal mechanisms.

sources.title: Identification of the surface species in electrochemical promotion: ethylene oxidation over a Pt/YSZ catalyst
sources.access: Indexed primary publisher text, direct open returned 403.
sources.use: Operando surface species distinguish promotion mechanisms; bulk signal absence is not a general causal exclusion.

sources.title: Breaking the activity-selectivity trade-off for acetylene semihydrogenation by Pd2 dual-atom site
sources.access: Current primary main article text retrieved. Page states updated after Author Correction on 17 August 2026.
sources.correction_access: Link/DOI located; correction body could not be fetched. Exact correction changes unverified.
sources.use: Static 93.2% selectivity/full reported conversion at 100 C comparator, not matched process superiority.

sources.title: Solvent-mediated electrochemical acetylene semihydrogenation for continuous production of polymer-grade ethylene
sources.access: Primary publisher preview/summary/introduction and partial methods retrieved via indexed search. Complete SI/raw performance/work data not acquired.
sources.use: Current same-output process comparator: source reports >99% selectivity, approximately full conversion, <5 ppm A and 200 h continuous flow; solvent/Cu interfacial selectivity already demonstrated.

sources.access: Primary article text and reaction-condition search excerpts.
sources.use: Static spillover route: about 95% selectivity and >99% conversion at 100 C, different A:H2:B feed.
